The city's own staff reasoning at 2023-06-12/06-27 states verbatim: 'the request to extend the temporary zone for a period of three (3) years ... does not encourage long-term redevelopment of the site in support of achieving London's Housing Pledge target of 47,000 units by 2031' and recommends only a 1-year extension instead, specifically 'to allow existing users of the surface commercial parking lot to make alternative parking arrangements while encouraging long-term redevelopment ... to a more intense, transit-supportive use ... that generates new housing units in the Downtown Core.'
